prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
competitors_mentioned: Law Offices of Stephen M. Fuerch
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer without knowing the details of your injuries and case. A reasonable starting point is to interview **two or three plaintiff-side car-accident lawyers** who regularly handle cases in the East Bay.

For a local option, the **Law Offices of Stephen M. Fuerch** lists a Pleasanton office and personal-injury practice: [fuerchlegal.com](https://www.fuerchlegal.com/) · (925) 463-2575. Treat that as a lead to compare—not an endorsement. You can also get a referral through the State Bar’s [lawyer-referral information](https://www.calbar.ca.gov/Public/Need-Legal-Help/Lawyer-Referral-Service).

Before hiring anyone:

- Check the lawyer’s **license status and discipline history** using the [State Bar attorney search](https://www.calbar.ca.gov/public/find-legal-professionals).
- Ask who will personally handle your case, their experience with similar injury claims, and whether they have taken cases to trial.
- Get the contingency-fee percentage and responsibility for case costs **in writing**; ask what you would owe if there’s no recovery.
- Speak with more than one lawyer and choose someone who explains the risks clearly and responds promptly.

If you’re still receiving medical care, prioritize that and keep records of treatment, expenses, missed work, and accident-related communications. Don’t sign a release or accept a settlement before you understand what it covers.
